sentences.text: 2.  This is an application seeking to quash F.I.R. in Crime No.0732/2022 registered by non-applicant No.1 for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 of Indian Penal Code, Sections 3(1)(zz)(iv), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(a), 30(2)(a), 59 and 26(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
3. Issue notice to the non-applicants returnable on 3.10.2024.
4. Mr. Amit Madiwale, learned A.P.P. waives notice for non-applicant No.1/State.

(MRS.VRUSHALI V.JOSHI, J.) (VINAY JOSHI, J.) Tambaskar.
